name: BNDES open data portal (CKAN datastore API)
operator: Banco Nacional de Desenvolvimento Economico e Social (BNDES)
tier_rationale: Federal development bank publishing its financing operations as open data (government body, A8 trusted); P246 'Official open data (BNDES, MinC, PNCP), tier trusted' (cond 5).

reliability.justification: The bank's own published operation tables (contract number, client CNPJ, amounts, dates); the full-text search matches loosely, so rows are post-filtered on the exact CNPJ.

ckan_operations.title: BNDES CKAN datastore_search over the financing-operation resources (non-automatic operations with full CNPJ; automatic indirect operations with masked CNPJ)

terms.quote: Official open data (BNDES, MinC, PNCP), tier trusted.

ckan_operations.notes: Quote: binding council text (P246 cond 5); research C0570 terms 'Open data (BNDES CKAN)' (verified_live 200, 2026-11-26). GET /api/3/action/datastore_search?resource_id=<id>&q=<CNPJ>&limit=20 only: a JSON 'filters' parameter is answered with an Apache 403 HTML page by the front WAF (prep capture), so it is never sent. Resource 6f56b78c-510f-44b6-8274-78a5b7e931f4 (operacoes nao automaticas, full formatted CNPJ, contract number) gives exact matches; 612faa0b-b6be-4b2c-9317-da5dc2c0b901 (operacoes indiretas automaticas) carries masked CNPJs and natural persons (masked CPF rows are dropped), so its rows are possible matches only. CKAN success=false envelopes are errors, never 'no operations'. Used by br_public_spending.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G10-2 (P246 br_public_spending). Throttled to 1 request/s, one at a time, answers cached 24 h (research: undocumented limit). No quota block. .br host: Accept-Language pt-BR by default.
